response.original_title: How long is recovery after laparoscopic surgery?
response.overview: Recovery after laparoscopic surgery is usually faster than traditional open surgery because the procedure is performed through small incisions. Most patients can return to light daily activities within a few days, while complete recovery may take around 2 to 6 weeks, depending on the type of surgery, the patient's overall health, and how well post-operative instructions are followed. Following your doctor's advice, eating a healthy diet, staying active as recommended, and attending follow-up appointments can help speed up recovery. If you are planning laparoscopic surgery in Rewari, choosing the best laparoscopic surgery hospital in Haryana is important for a smooth recovery. An experienced laparoscopic surgeon in Haryana will provide personalised guidance before and after surgery, helping reduce the risk of complications and ensuring the best possible outcome. Proper medical care and regular follow-up play a key role in achieving a safe and comfortable recovery.
